description: "A Briefe Introduction to Geography" by William Pemble is a geographical treatise written in the early 17th century. This book serves as an educational guide intended for young students delving into the study of geography, offering a foundational understanding of the Earth’s surfaces, properties, and divisions, along with geographical concepts.
